# CANDIDATE: RSI_DIVERGENCE_AT_NAMED_LEVEL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When price approaches a significant named level (prior day high, prior day low, session VWAP, or prior week high/low) within 0.2% of price and RSI shows bearish divergence, the likelihood of a reversal increases. This combines mean-reversion at key levels with momentum exhaustion signals to improve entry timing beyond pure price-action approaches.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: Identify the nearest named level (prior day high, prior day low, session VWAP, or prior week high/low) within 0.2% of price; if price makes a higher high than the prior bar while RSI(14) makes a lower high (bearish divergence) and the bar closes below its open, then enter short at the bar close.
Exit shape: chart-stop at the recent swing high (prior high before entry), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 15% off HWM.
Regime hint: Best in ranging markets where ribbon width is stable (0.003‑0.006) and VIX between 13‑20; avoid strong trending ribbon (monotonic EMA slope).
